newsitem.title: UK: UK's Select Appointments sees ADS offer cut.
newsitem.headline: UK's Select Appointments sees ADS offer cut.

text.p: UK staffing services firm Select Appointments Plc said on Friday it expected the size of its planned U.S. offering to be reduced and added that the offering price would be below its expected range.
The company previously said it expected the U.S. offering to include about 5.2 million American Depositary Shares (ADSs) at $13.50 to $15.50 per ADS.
Each ADS would represent two ordinary shares.
The company, citing a downgrade of the market rating of the staffing services sector in the U.S., said it expected the offering would not now include a secondary offer of existing ordinary shares.
However, the company said it continued to believe a Nasdaq listing was in the best interests of its shareholders.
Select's shares sank 11 percent, or 43.5p to 345p by 1425 GMT, making it one of the top percentage losers on the London Stock Exchange.
Select said in a statement it was engaged in different business areas of the staffing services sector than companies covered by recent downgrades.

"The directors note that Select is not principally engaged in large, long-term contract business, particularly in the U.S., and is therefore not subject to margin pressures affecting those companies servicing this market," the company said.
